title: Stochastic cohort accuracy proctor with temporal drift simulations
creator: Priya Desai
description: Build an automated validation harness that verifies FP8/INT8 calibration profiles against a set of stochastic cohorts and temporal-drift scenarios. This proctor evaluates fidelity across cohort slices (domain, prompt-length, token-distribution), runs simulated drift perturbations (vocab shifts, context-truncation, prompt-noise), and emits deterministic pass/fail signals that can gate canary rollouts and CI merges.
acceptance_criteria: Harness executes a configurable suite of 10+ cohorts and returns deterministic pass/fail results within CI (max 90s runtime for smoke subset)
Provides per-cohort metrics: EM-measure, embedding-cosine-stability, token-level KL and top-k overlap; thresholds configurable per-release
Generates structured artifacts: per-run CSV of metrics, per-cohort diff-driven summary, and a human-readable report pushed to the release dashboard
Integrates with canary automation: failing gate prevents rollout and creates ENG ticket with linked artifacts
Supports seeding for stochastic replay so failed runs are reproducible for debugging
plan_steps: 1) Define cohort taxonomy and sampling rules (domain, length buckets, frequency weight)
2) Implement drift simulators: vocab-replacement, paraphrase noise, context-sparsification
3) Build harness runner that accepts model variant matrix and quant-profile matrix
4) Compute metrics and evaluation heuristics, emit pass/fail decisions and artifact bundle
5) Wire into CI and canary pipeline with conditional rollback hook
6) Run baseline runs for recent releases to calibrate thresholds and tune sensitivity
7) Document runbook and hand over to SRE/Release owners
metrics: Exact-match-like metric (EM%): fail if delta > 2.5% compared to float baseline on high-signal cohorts
Embedding stability: median cosine similarity < 0.985 marks a soft-warning, < 0.97 fails
Token-level KL divergence: weighted KL > 0.12 on conversational cohorts fails
Top-k overlap (k=5): overlap drop > 10% on instruction cohorts triggers fail
Temporal consistency: percentile drift (99th) across 30-day simulated shift > configured threshold fails
qa_plan: Create canonical baseline runs using float32 model for the selected week of traffic
Run harness with three quant-profile variants: int8-default, int8-layer-gated, fp8-adaptive
Introduce synthetic perturbations and verify harness flags the intentionally degraded variants
Have ML reviewer validate edge cases (rare tokens, long-tail code examples)
Run on dedicated staging hardware that mirrors runtime-1.20 GPUs to validate kernel determinism

tradeoffs_notes: Deterministic seeding vs. true stochastic breadth: seeding reduces coverage of rare draws but makes failures actionable
Strict pass/fail gates reduce risk but increase false positives — we add a 'soft-warning' channel to accumulate small regressions
Running full cohort matrix in CI is expensive; plan to run compact smoke subset on PRs and full sweep in canary/pre-release
integration_and_ops: CI: smoke-suite run on PRs under 90s with artifact upload on success/failure
Canary: full-suite runs during canary stage; failing gate triggers rollback and creates ENG ticket with S3 artifacts
Alerting: critical failures page to #release-alerts Slack with link to artifact bundle and reproducible seed
Observability: each run ships telemetry (metrics+histograms) to the quant dashboard for longitudinal trend analysis
rollback_policy: If any high-sensitivity cohort fails (EM delta > 2.5% or embedding cosine < 0.97) during canary, abort rollout, mark release as 'blocked', create ENG ticket with run artifacts and assign to release owner
